title: Recurring mall dream
content: I read a thread in HighStrangeness about recurring dreams about Malls and places of commerce, and followed the link here. I'm an older guy, 60, and have had two distinct recurring dreams throughout my life. Will create a separate post for each - 1) Elevators in a tall place of business 2) Malls This is long: 2) Had this dream for over 20 years. Would have it a few times a month. It has since stopped. The dream centers around being lost in a mall, trying to find a specific office or place of business ( I'm not sure, because I never do find it). It will start off with me either driving to the mall and leaving my car on a side street, or taking public transit, or just already being inside the mall when the dream begins. Typical mall setting, lots of tile floor, pillars, neon lights, open front stores, people milling about. I know the mall. Been there many times before in the dream. In the dream I have to find a specific place, and have an idea of where I'm supposed to go, but cannot seem to get there, because doors are not where they should be, or hallways lead to the wrong area. Or escalators are taken apart for service. That type of silly frustration that is blocking things. I've been there before and know where I'm going, except for some reason, things are not where they should be. I end up pacing back and forth, retracing my steps in case I missed the doors, but ..nope. Not there. So, I make a plan to go a different path, and end up totally lost. I find other doorways, end up going down hallways, and steps to other floors. That causes me to be on a different level of the mall, or exiting the mall, and finding myself several blocks from where i think I should be. And having to run along he sidewalk outside to a different building to try and get back into the mall. Once inside, I have to recalculate my location to try to find the place I need to be. Again, doors don't lead to areas as expected, I ask other shoppers for directions, and they're all just confused and are no help at all. At some point, I usually end up in a cafeteria type place. Very large. Lots of tables and people. I'm in a line, trying to find a tray and plate to slide along the metal railing track that is in front of the typical cafeteria sections that have cafeteria ladies on the other side who will put some food on your plate as you move along. For me, it's always Chinese food. LOL. At least that part of the dream is great. I'm usually really happy at the selection, and having the chance to have some cafeteria Chinese food. Sad, but I never do actually sit down and eat it though. Anyway, I next find myself back out in the mall, lost and looking for some place that I had been a million times, but for some reason can't seem to find it this time. Had this recurring frustrating mall / cafeteria dream for over 20 years. It stopped several years ago.
